# Objective

Compare a simple equal-weight forecast average with covariance-estimated sum-to-one weights on a later synthetic holdout.

# Run

```bash
python python/qm024_forecast_combination.py
```

# Experiment

Change the estimation-window length or error correlation. Estimated weights may become unstable and need not outperform equal weights out of sample.

The data are synthetic and do not establish an empirical advantage for either combination rule.
